headline: Singapore and China Initiate Talks to Upgrade Bilateral Free Trade Agreement
summary: Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong and Chinese President Xi Jinping welcomed the launch of negotiations to upgrade their existing free trade pact, focusing on artificial intelligence and digital innovation.
why: Singapore is a key regional financial center, while China is Southeast Asia's largest trade partner.

impacts.name: Singapore
impacts.why: Upgrading trade agreements creates expansion opportunities for cross-border AI and technology cooperation.
